Class ColumnIdentifierRule

java.lang.Object
org.apache.openjpa.lib.identifier.IdentifierRule
org.apache.openjpa.jdbc.identifier.DBIdentifierRule
org.apache.openjpa.jdbc.identifier.ColumnIdentifierRule
public class ColumnIdentifierRule extends DBIdentifierRule
Default rule for column names. Column names which are forbidden as column names will get detected properly. Those reserved words might differ from the general reserved words.
